adapted_frame.gauge_action: B' = B + d h + A9 h - h A3
adapted_frame.invariant: [B] in the connection-extension quotient by D_Hom(h)

Q_test.prerequisite: Q is absent from the diagonal M9 and W3 connections at its generic point
Q_test.allowed_gauges: triangular gauges regular at the generic point of Q=0
Q_test.positive_result: the logarithmic polar part of B is nonzero modulo D_Hom of admissible gauges
Q_test.negative_result: the polar part is removable by an admissible triangular gauge
Q_test.forbidden_inference: a Q denominator in one chosen representative B

nested_infinity_checks: R_inf has rank 2 and kernel rank 7 on M9
R_inf is horizontal for A9 and the elliptic connection
marked residue and infinity-Gysin squares use source-derived orientations
no splitting is selected by sparsity, denominator minimization, or Q
